answer: Sample 5 percent of submissions each epoch. Re-execute on a second machine and compare outputs. When peers disagree, dilute the reward by the spread instead of voiding it. Vest every reward against work in later epochs. Auditing 5 percent of 1,000 daily answers is 50 re-executions, cheap for the network, while a farm needs every copy to survive. One anchor of mismatch drags the batch onto the reef, and the ocean of retries costs more than the reward.
